question: Mr. Ramesh has a sister named Mrs. Kamlesh. Mrs. Kamlesh has two kids named Mr. Luv and Mr. Kush. Mr. Kush's father's wife's mother is Mrs. Rupa. Mrs. Rupa's daughter is Ms. Rekha. Mrs. Kamlesh is Ms. Rekha's _____.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44b1d977930a5ae8ff2ad87e3b6407517b08dce70e8f045c243365162391bc53.png] 

Drawing a family tree by given information is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17a1a8a39e296deac2ae7fa472d81c5f96ff099ae4e5744047b4d6fc7b88da7b.png] 

Mrs. Kamlesh is Ms. Rekha's **Sister.**

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the **correct answer.**
